id: \bWe aren't taking any passengers right now. Sorry.
en: \bWe aren't taking any passengers right now. Sorry.
it: \bAl momento non accettiamo passeggeri. Mi dispiace.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

id: \bI'm always willing to teach this move to travelers.
en: \bI'm always willing to teach this move to travelers.
it: \bSono sempre disposto a insegnare questa mossa ai viaggiatori.

id: \bIsn't this place amazing?! I can run around on actual tiles.
en: \bIsn't this place amazing?! I can run around on actual tiles.
it: \bNon è fantastico questo posto?! Posso correre su delle vere piastrelle.

id: \bNot bad at all. Kukui is doing you well.
en: \bNot bad at all. Kukui is doing you well.
it: \bNiente male davvero. Kukui ti sta allenando bene.

id: Rotom Dex: Great work. Let's head back to the school.
en: Rotom Dex: Great work. Let's head back to the school.
it: Rotom Dex: Ottimo lavoro. Torniamo a scuola.

id: \bHold it! That Pokémon destroyed my golden safe. There's no way I'm letting anyone get in my way to make it pay for what it did.
en: \bHold it! That Pokémon destroyed my golden safe.  There's no way I'm letting anyone get in my way to make it pay for what it did.
it: \bAlt! Quel Pokémon ha distrutto la mia cassaforte d'oro.  Non permetterò a nessuno di mettersi in mezzo mentre gliela faccio pagare.

id: \bEh, get lost. I'll earn it back some other way.
en: \bEh, get lost. I'll earn it back some other way.
it: \bEh, sparisci. Recupererò i soldi in qualche altro modo.

id: \bTupp: Yo, you again. Beat it, this girl's Pokémon is ours.
en: \bTupp: Yo, you again. Beat it, this girl's Pokémon is ours.
it: \bTupp: Ehi, ancora tu. Smamma, i Pokémon di questa ragazza sono nostri.

id: \bTupp: No way. Yo, this isn't cool. Let's get out of here.
en: \bTupp: No way. Yo, this isn't cool. Let's get out of here.
it: \bTupp: Non ci credo. Yo, così non è figo. Filiamo via di qui.

id: Rotom Dex: I think that's all the professor had for us today. Let's go back home.
en: Rotom Dex: I think that's all the professor had for us today. Let's go back home.
it: Rotom Dex: Credo che per oggi il professore non avesse altro per noi. Torniamo a casa.

id: This ball contain a Marshadow. Would you like to take it?
en: This ball contain a Marshadow. Would you like to take it?
it: Questa Ball contiene un Marshadow. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: \rRapp: Yo, what do you think you're doing?
en: \rRapp: Yo, what do you think you're doing?
it: \rRapp: Yo, che cavolo credi di fare?

id: Hau'oli City\nA city overflowing with gentle joy.
en: Hau'oli City\nA city overflowing with gentle joy.
it: Hau'oli\nUna città traboccante di dolce allegria.

id: \bWhat do you MEAN I missed it?!
en: \bWhat do you MEAN I missed it?!
it: \bCOSA vuol dire che me lo sono perso?!

id: \rMina: Thanks for your help... Want to make some art? Or are you more interested in that strange Pokémon near the school?
en: \rMina: Thanks for your help... Want to make some art? Or are you more interested in that strange Pokémon near the school?
it: \rMina: Grazie per l'aiuto... Ti va di creare un po' d'arte? O ti interessa di più quello strano Pokémon vicino alla scuola?

id: \rLana: \PN, what a surprise. You caught me just before I shipped out again.
en: \rLana: \PN, what a surprise. You caught me just before I shipped out again.
it: \rSuiren: \PN, che sorpresa. Mi hai beccata appena prima che ripartissi per mare.

id: \rI could use a break and stretch my legs though.
en: \rI could use a break and stretch my legs though.
it: \rPerò mi farebbe comodo una pausa per sgranchirmi le gambe.

id: \rLana: I guess it's time I got back out there with my dad.
en: \rLana: I guess it's time I got back out there with my dad.
it: \rSuiren: Direi che è ora di tornare in mare con mio padre.

id: It's the wild Litten that's been roaming around. Would you like to take it with you?
en: It's the wild Litten that's been roaming around. Would you like to take it with you?
it: È il Litten selvatico che gironzolava qui intorno. Vuoi portarlo con te?

id: \rLana: You finally showed up. I'm going to take you to an island so we can find some cool Water Pokémon. Are you ready to go?
en: \rLana: You finally showed up. I'm going to take you to an island so we can find some cool Water Pokémon. Are you ready to go?
it: \rSuiren: Finalmente sei arrivato. Ti porterò su un'isola per trovare dei fantastici Pokémon di tipo Acqua. Sei pronto a partire?

id: \rLana: I had fun today. Talk to Lapras if you ever want to go back.
en: \rLana: I had fun today. Talk to Lapras if you ever want to go back.
it: \rSuiren: Oggi mi sono divertita. Parla con Lapras se vuoi tornarci.

id: \bIt's nice to see someone standing up to those Team Skull punks. You deserve this.
en: \bIt's nice to see someone standing up to those Team Skull punks. You deserve this.
it: \bChe bello vedere qualcuno che tiene testa a quei teppisti del Team Skull. Te lo meriti.

id: \rLusamine is never home. It's a shame since she has such a big house.
en: \rLusamine is never home. It's a shame since she has such a big house.
it: \rSamina non è mai a casa. È un peccato, ha una casa così grande.

id: \bYou seem like a nice person. Please take this.
en: \bYou seem like a nice person. Please take this.
it: \bSembri una persona gentile. Prendi questo, per favore.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?\ch[1,-1, Paniola,Aether,Vast Poni Canyon,Mount Lanakila,Exit]
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?\ch[1,-1, Paniola,Aether,Vast Poni Canyon,Mount Lanakila,Exit]
it: \bBenvenuto. Dove vuoi andare?\ch[1,-1, Paniola,Aether,Gran Canyon di Poni,Monte Lanakila,Esci]

id: \rThe restaurant here is so good. You should try it out for sure.
en: \rThe restaurant here is so good. You should try it out for sure.
it: \rIl ristorante qui è buonissimo. Devi assolutamente provarlo.
